name: Android (Material Design 3)
description: Android mobile apps following Material Design accessibility guidelines
guidelines: Material Design 3: All touch targets must be at least 48dp (9mm physical)
Material Design 3: Interactive elements need visual affordance via fill contrast, tonal elevation, or border (WCAG 1.4.11)
Material Design 3: Bottom navigation should have 3-5 destinations
Android: Text must use scalable sp units; minimum 12sp, recommended 14sp+ for body
